summary: Thomson Reuters filed a 6-K reporting Q2 2026 results and disclosed a definitive agreement to sell a 51% stake in its Global Print business to KKR, forming a joint venture. Thomson Reuters will receive approximately $500 million in gross proceeds on closing. The filing also notes completed capital returns: $605 million return of capital on May 4, 2026, a $600 million share repurchase program, and repayment of $500 million notes. The transaction aligns with the company's strategic focus on AI solutions. No specific price per share or premium is stated; the deal's closing timing and regulatory aspects remain to be detailed, presenting a watch item for completion and proceeds use.
